name: accumulatetime
description: The number of seconds since the race has started.
exampleMeaning: The race has been ongoing for at least 5 seconds.

name: activate_count_all
description: The number of skills you have activated in the race.
exampleMeaning: You have activated at least 7 skills so far.

name: activate_count_all_team
description: The characters on your team have cumulatively activated the specified number of skills.
exampleMeaning: The characters on your team have cumulatively activated 10 skills or more.

name: activate_count_end_after
description: The number of skills you have activated in the Late-Race or later.
exampleMeaning: You've activated at least 3 skills during the Late-Race or the Last Spurt.

name: activate_count_heal
description: The number of recovery (healing) skills you have activated during the race.
exampleMeaning: You have activated at least one recovery skill during the race.

name: activate_count_later_half
description: You've activated the specified amount of skills in the second half of the race.
exampleMeaning: You've activated at least 2 skills in the second half of the race.

name: activate_count_middle
description: The number of skills you have activated in the Mid-Race.
exampleMeaning: You've activated at least 3 skills during the Mid-Race.

name: activate_count_start
description: The number of skills you have activated in the Early-Race.
exampleMeaning: You've activated at least 3 skills during the Early-Race.

name: all_corner_random
description: Picks a random point during any corner.
exampleMeaning: A random point on a random corner is selected.
note: To be more precise, this condition randomly picks four points (each time rolls a random corner, and then a random point on that corner). That means that if the skill in question has a short cooldown, there are multiple points where it can activate this way.

name: always
description: Always activates.
exampleMeaning: This skill has no particular conditions.

name: base_guts
description: Your guts stat.
exampleMeaning: Your guts stat is 1200 or higher.

name: base_power
description: Your power stat.
exampleMeaning: Your power stat is 1200 or higher.

name: base_speed
description: Your speed stat.
exampleMeaning: Your speed stat is 1200 or higher.

name: base_stamina
description: Your stamina stat.
exampleMeaning: Your Stamina stat is 1200 or higher.

name: base_wiz
description: Your wisdom stat.
exampleMeaning: Your wisdom stat is 1200 or higher.

name: bashin_diff_behind
description: Horse lengths between you and the closest uma behind you.
exampleMeaning: There's another uma at most one horse length behind you.

name: bashin_diff_infront
description: Horse lengths between you and the closest uma ahead of you.
exampleMeaning: There's another uma at most one horse length ahead of you.

name: behind_near_lane_time
description: The number of seconds there's another uma right behind you.
exampleMeaning: Another uma has been right behind you for at least 3 seconds.
note: "Right behind" means no more than 2.5 meters behind, and no more than 1 lane (1/18 of the track's width) to either side. It doesn't have to be the same uma (as long as there's at least one), but if your own placement changes, the timer will reset.

name: behind_near_lane_time_set1
description: The number of seconds there's another uma behind you.
exampleMeaning: Another uma has been behind you for at least 1 seconds.
note: This is similar to behind_near_lane_time with different values. "Behind" here means no more than 5 meters behind, and no more than 2.7 lanes (2.7/18 of the track's width) to either side. It doesn't have to be the same uma (as long as there's at least one), but if your own placement changes, the timer will reset.

name: blocked_all_continuetime
description: The number of seconds you've been blocked from the front and at least one side simultaneously.
exampleMeaning: You've been blocked by other umas both in front and on the side for at least one second.

name: blocked_front
description: Checks if you're currently being blocked by someone in front of you.
exampleMeaning: Someone is right in front of you.

name: blocked_front_continuetime
description: The number of seconds you've been blocked from the front.
exampleMeaning: You've been blocked by another uma in front of you for at least a second.

name: blocked_side_continuetime
description: The number of seconds you've been blocked from at least one side.
exampleMeaning: You've been blocked by another uma from either side for at least 2 seconds.

name: change_order_onetime
description: Checks if your position in the race has changed.
exampleMeaning: You've overtaken another uma.
note: Positive number means being overtaken, negative number means overtaking someone.

name: change_order_up_end_after
description: Checks how many times you've overtaken someone after entering the Late-Race.
exampleMeaning: You have overtaken another girl at least 3 times since entering the Late-Race.

name: change_order_up_finalcorner_after
description: Checks how many times you've overtaken someone after entering the Final Corner.
exampleMeaning: You have overtaken another girl at least 3 times since entering the Final Corner.

name: change_order_up_middle
description: Checks how many times you've overtaken someone during the Mid-Race.
exampleMeaning: You have overtaken another girl at least 3 times during the Mid-Race.

name: compete_fight_count
description: The number of times you've been in a Showdown.
exampleMeaning: You participated in at least one Showdown (追い比べ) during the Final Straight.
note: Showdown (追い比べ) refers to the mechanic where directly competing with another girl on the Final Straight will give you extra speed and acceleration based on your guts.

name: corner
description: Checks if you're currently on a corner (and if yes, then which one).
exampleMeaning: You're currently on any corner.
note: For example, "first corner" refers to the first corner on the racetrack, not necessarily the first corner you pass through. This condition is often also used as "corner!=0", meaning any corner.

name: corner_count
description: Checks how many corners the racetrack has.
exampleMeaning: The racetrack has no corners.

name: corner_random
description: Picks a random point during the selected corner.
exampleMeaning: A random point on the first corner is selected.
note: If the race goes through the same corner multiple times, it will always activate at the last possible opportunity.

name: course_distance
description: The length of the current race.
exampleMeaning: The current race is exactly 2400 meters long.

name: distance_diff_rate
description: Your position between the currently first and the currently last girl as a percentage.
exampleMeaning: If there's a 100-meter gap between the first and the last uma, you're no further than 30 meters behind the first one.

name: distance_diff_top
description: The distance in meters between the first place and you.
exampleMeaning: There's at least 7 meters difference between the character currently in the first place and you.
note: This condition only uses whole numbers. See distance_diff_top_float for the same condition with floating point numbers.

name: distance_diff_top_float
description: The distance in decimeters between the first place and you.
exampleMeaning: There's at most a 2.5 meters difference between the character currently in the first place and you.
note: Divide the number by 10 to get the difference in meters. A value of 25 means a difference of 2.5 meters.

name: distance_rate
description: Race progression in percentage.
exampleMeaning: Race is in its half or later.

name: distance_rate_after_random
description: Picks a random point after the specified point in the race.
exampleMeaning: Picks a random point in the second half (i.e. after 50%) of the race.
note: The number is in percentage, for example, 50 meaning 50% of the race.

name: distance_type
description: The distance type of the current race.
exampleMeaning: The current race is long.

name: down_slope_random
description: Picks a random point on any downhill.
exampleMeaning: A random point on any downhill part of the race is selected.

name: fan_count
description: Checks the number of your fans.
exampleMeaning: You have at least 146738 fans.

name: furlong
description: Furlong is a measure of distance equivalent to 1/8 of a mile, or 201.168 meters.
exampleMeaning: Activates during the third furlong (approximately between 600-800 meters into the race).

name: grade
description: The grade of the current race.
exampleMeaning: The current race is of grade G1.
note: All the "big" races without a specified grade (URA Finals, Champions Meeting, Team Trials, etc.) generally fall into the 100 (G1) category.

name: ground_condition
description: The current condition of the track.
exampleMeaning: The track is in good condition.

name: ground_type
description: The ground type of the current race.
exampleMeaning: The race is taking place on a dirt track.

name: hp_per
description: Your remaining HP (stamina) in percentage.
exampleMeaning: You have at most 70% stamina remaining.

name: infront_near_lane_time
description: The number of seconds there's another uma right in front of you.
exampleMeaning: Another uma has been right in front of you for at least 3 seconds.
note: "Right in front" means no more than 2.5 meters ahead, and no more than 1 lane (1/18 of the track's width) to either side. It doesn't have to be the same uma (as long as there's at least one), but if your own placement changes, the timer will reset.

name: is_abroad
description: Check whether the race takes place abroad (relative to Japan).
exampleMeaning: The race takes place outside of Japan.

name: is_activate_any_skill
description: Checks if any other skill has just been activated.
exampleMeaning: You have just used another skill.

name: is_activate_heal_skill
description: Activates when you use a stamina recovery skill.
exampleMeaning: You've just recovered stamina with a skill.
note: Afaik this means 'activated at this very moment' rather than 'activated somewhere during the race'. So 'phase_firsthalf==1&is_activate_heal_skill==1' would mean 'you're in the first half of the Middle Leg and you *just* used the skill now'.

name: is_activate_other_skill_detail
description: A different trigger of this skill was activated during the race.
exampleMeaning: You activated "Trigger 1" of this skill at some earlier point of the race.

name: is_badstart
description: Checks if you've had a late start to the current race.
exampleMeaning: You haven't had a late start to the current race.
note: Late start" refers to starting gate reaction time of over 0.08 seconds.

name: is_basis_distance
description: The distance type of the track.
exampleMeaning: The total distance of the race is divisible by 400 (e.g. 1600, 2000, 2400)
note: Core" distance is divisible by 400, "non-core" distance isn't.

name: is_behind_in
description: Checks if the girl behind you is closer to the inner fence than you.
exampleMeaning: The uma behind you is closer to the inner fence than you.

name: is_dirtgrade
description: The race is an exchange race (takes place at either the Kawasaki, Funabashi, Morioka, or Ooi racetrack)
exampleMeaning: The current race is an exchange race (takes place at either the Kawasaki, Funabashi, Morioka, or Ooi racetrack)
note: More generally, any race held on a racetrack which is considered to be a 「地方」 (local) racetrack (as opposed to the bigger 「中央」 (Center) racetracks) will count for this.

name: is_exist_chara_id
description: Checks if a character with the given ID is participating in the race.
exampleMeaning: Silence Suzuka is running in the current race.
note: Only checks for the character, not the version of her. If a seasonal version of an uma exists, it would fulfill the condition too.

name: is_exist_skill_id
description: Checks if anyone in the race has the specified skill.
exampleMeaning: Someone in the race has the Sympathy skill.

name: is_finalcorner
description: Checks if you're currently on the final corner or beyond.
exampleMeaning: You're currently on the last corner or beyond it.
note: "Beyond" means that this can activate on the final straight if there's one after the final corner. However, if there are no corners in the race, this will never activate.

name: is_finalcorner_laterhalf
description: Checks if you're currently on the second half of the final corner.
exampleMeaning: You're on the second half of the final corner.

name: is_finalcorner_random
description: Picks a random point on the final corner. The skill will activate there if all other conditions are met.
exampleMeaning: A random point on the final corner.
note: Unlike is_finalcorner, this condition refers to the actual last corner only (can't pick a point on the last straight).

name: is_goodstart
description: This condition is probably new. Currently under investigation.

name: is_hp_empty_onetime
description: Checks if your HP (stamina) had been depleted at some point in the race.
exampleMeaning: You're out of stamina, or had been previously.

name: is_last_straight
description: Checks if you're currently on the final straight of the course.
exampleMeaning: You're currently on the final straight of the course.
note: If a course only has one straight, the first straight is the last straight.

name: is_last_straight_onetime
description: Checks if you've just entered the last straight.
exampleMeaning: You have just arrived at the last straight.

name: is_lastspurt
description: Checks if you're currently in the last spurt.
exampleMeaning: You're in the last spurt mode.
note: This does not refer to the Last Spurt phase of the race, but to the last spurt mode of the character. After entering the Late-Race, when the character has enough stamina to finish the rest of the race at max speed, she will enter a "last spurt" mode. That's what this condition refers to.

name: is_move_lane
description: Checks if you've just moved left or right.
exampleMeaning: You've just moved closer to the inner fence.

name: is_other_character_activate_advantage_skill
description: A character other than you has activated an advantageous (i.e. non-debuff) skill of a specific type.
exampleMeaning: Someone has activated a healing skill.

name: is_overtake
description: Checks if you have any overtake targets.
exampleMeaning: You have at least one overtake target.
note: A girl is an overtake target if she's up to 20 meters ahead of you, and you can catch up with her within 15 seconds at the current speed.

name: is_popularity_top_character_activate_advantage_skill
description: This condition is probably new. Currently under investigation.

name: is_surrounded
description: Checks if you're currently surrounded.
exampleMeaning: You're currently surrounded by other girls.
note:
You're being surrounded if there are other uma musume that fulfill the following conditions:
— No more than 3 meters ahead of you, and less than 1.5 lanes difference between you
— No more than 3 meters behind you, and less than 1.5 lanes difference between you
— Less than 1.5 meters behind or ahead of you, and less than 3 lanes difference between you, but not the same lane
In simpler terms, this will usually mean that there's an uma in front of you, behind you, and next to you. It's technically possible for one girl to fulfill two of these conditions (someone passing you from the adjacent line), so two umas can still surround you.

name: is_temptation
description: Checks if you're currently rushing (kakari).
exampleMeaning: You're currently not rushing.

name: is_tight_track
description: Check whether the racetrack has tight corners.
exampleMeaning: The racetrack has tight corners.
note: Afaik this should Sapporo, Hakodate, Fukushima, Kokura, Kawasaki, and Funabashi.

name: is_used_skill_id
description: Checks whether you've activated a specific skill during this race.
exampleMeaning: You've activated the Great Escape skill during this race.

name: is_used_skill_id_with_detail_one
description: This condition is probably new. Currently under investigation.

name: lane_type
description: The lane you're currently running in.
exampleMeaning: You're currently running right next to the inner fence.

name: last_straight_random
description: Picks a random point on the last straight.
exampleMeaning: A random point on the last straight is selected.

name: lastspurt
description: Checks if you can carry out your last spurt.
exampleMeaning: You have more than enough stamina (HP) left to carry out your last spurt at full strength.
note: This does not refer to the Last Spurt phase of the race, but to the last spurt mode of the character. After entering the Late-Race, when the character has enough stamina to finish the rest of the race at max speed, she will enter a "last spurt" mode.

name: motivation
description: Your Mood going into the race.
exampleMeaning: Your motivation is Good or better.

name: near_count
description: The number of other girls that are currently near you.
exampleMeaning: There are exactly four other girls near you.
note: "Near" means no further than 3 meters behind/ahead, and no further than 3 lanes to either side. 1 lane equals to 1/18 of the track's width.

name: near_infront_count
description: The number of other girls right in front of you at the moment.
exampleMeaning: There's nobody right in front of you.
note: "Right in front" means no more than 2.5 meters ahead.

name: order
description: Your current position in the race.
exampleMeaning: You're currently first, second, or third.

name: order_rate
description: Your current position in the race as a percentage.
exampleMeaning: You're in the second half of the pack.
note: Converted to the nearest integer first. For example, order_rate > 50 in a 9-uma race would be x > round(9*50%) => x > round(4.5) => x > 5. So your position needs to be 6th or worse, not 5th or worse as you might expect.

name: order_rate_in20_continue
description: Your position has been within the top 20% for the entire race until now.
exampleMeaning: Your position in the race was never worse than top 20% after the first 5 seconds (for example, in a 10-uma race, you were never worse than 2nd).
note: The first 5 seconds of the race don't count, so you have time to establish your position. Same as with normal order_rate, the percentage is converted to the nearest integer first.

name: order_rate_in40_continue
description: Your position has been within the top 40% for the entire race until now.
exampleMeaning: Your position in the race was never worse than top 40% after the first 5 seconds (for example, in a 10-uma race, you were never worse than 4th).
note: The first 5 seconds of the race don't count, so you have time to establish your position. Same as with normal order_rate, the percentage is converted to the nearest integer first.

name: order_rate_in50_continue
description: Your position has been within the top 50% for the entire race until now.
exampleMeaning: Your position in the race was never worse than top 50% after the first 5 seconds (for example, in a 10-uma race, you were never worse than 5th).
note: The first 5 seconds of the race don't count, so you have time to establish your position. Same as with normal order_rate, the percentage is converted to the nearest integer first.

name: order_rate_in80_continue
description: Your position has been within the top 80% for the entire race until now.
exampleMeaning: Your position in the race was never worse than top 80% after the first 5 seconds (for example, in a 10-uma race, you were never worse than 8th).
note: The first 5 seconds of the race don't count, so you have time to establish your position. Same as with normal order_rate, the percentage is converted to the nearest integer first.

name: order_rate_out20_continue
description: Your position has been worse than the top 20% for the entire race until now.
exampleMeaning: Your position in the race was always outside of the top 20% (so within the last 80%). For example, in a 9-uma race, you were always 2nd or worse.
note: The first 5 seconds of the race don't count, so you have time to establish your position. Same as with normal order_rate, the percentage is converted to the nearest integer first.

name: order_rate_out40_continue
description: Your position has been worse than the top 40% for the entire race until now.
exampleMeaning: Your position in the race was always outside of the top 40% (so within the last 60%). For example, in a 9-uma race, you were always 4th or worse.
note: The first 5 seconds of the race don't count, so you have time to establish your position. Same as with normal order_rate, the percentage is converted to the nearest integer first.

name: order_rate_out50_continue
description: Your position has been worse than the top 50% for the entire race until now.
exampleMeaning: Your position in the race was always outside of the top 50% (so within the last 50%). For example, in a 9-uma race, you were always 5th or worse.
note: The first 5 seconds of the race don't count, so you have time to establish your position. Same as with normal order_rate, the percentage is converted to the nearest integer first.

name: order_rate_out70_continue
description: Your position has been worse than the top 70% for the entire race until now.
exampleMeaning: Your position in the race was always outside of the top 70% (so within the last 30%). For example, in a 9-uma race, you were always 6th or worse.
note: The first 5 seconds of the race don't count, so you have time to establish your position. Same as with normal order_rate, the percentage is converted to the nearest integer first.

name: overtake_target_no_order_up_time
description: The number of seconds you've had any overtake targets.
exampleMeaning: You've had at least one overtake target for at least two seconds.
note: A girl is an overtake target if she's up to 20 meters ahead of you, and if you can catch up with her within 15 seconds at the current speed.

name: overtake_target_time
description: The number of seconds you've been an overtake target.
exampleMeaning: You've been an overtake target for at least 2 seconds.
note: You're an overtake target of another girl if you're up to 20 meters ahead of her, and if she can catch up with you within 15 seconds at the current speed.

name: phase
description: Current phase of the race.
exampleMeaning: You're currently either in the Late-Race or the Last Spurt.

name: phase_corner_random
description: Picks a random point during a corner on the selected phase. The skill will activate there if all other conditions are met.
exampleMeaning: A random point during a corner in the Mid-Race.

name: phase_first_half_straight_random
description: Picks a random point on any straight in the first half of the given phase.
exampleMeaning: A random point on any straight in the first half of the Middle Leg is selected.

name: phase_firsthalf
description: Checks if you're in the first half of the selected phase.
exampleMeaning: You're anywhere in the first half of the Middle Leg.

name: phase_firsthalf_random
description: Picks a random point during the first half of the selected phase.
exampleMeaning: A random point on the first half of the Mid-Race is selected.

name: phase_firstquarter
description: Checks if you're in the first quarter of the selected phase.
exampleMeaning: You're anywhere in the first quarter of the Middle Leg.

name: phase_firstquarter_random
description: Picks a random point during the first quarter of the selected phase.
exampleMeaning: A random point on the first quarter of the Mid-Race is selected.

name: phase_laterhalf
description: Checks if you're in the second half of the selected phase.
exampleMeaning: You're anywhere in the second half of the Middle Leg.

name: phase_laterhalf_random
description: Picks a random point during the second half of the selected phase. The skill will activate there if all other conditions are met.
exampleMeaning: A random point in the second half of the Early-Race.

name: phase_latter_half_straight_random
description: Picks a random point on any straight in the second half of the given phase.
exampleMeaning: A random point on any straight in the second half of the Middle Leg is selected.

name: phase_random
description: Picks a random point during the selected phase. The skill will activate there if all other conditions are met.
exampleMeaning: A random point in the Early-Race.

name: phase_straight_random
description: Picks a random point on any straight in the given phase.
exampleMeaning: A random point on any straight in the Middle Leg is selected.

name: popularity
description: Your popularity rank among the girls in the current race.
exampleMeaning: You're the most popular girl in the race.

name: post_number
description: The starting gate block you started to race in.
exampleMeaning: You started the race in starting gate blocks 1, 2, or 3.
note: Gate block is not the same as the gate number. In races with a lot of participants, one block can have several gates.

name: random_lot
description: Rolls a random number from 0-100.
exampleMeaning: 50% chance for activation.
note: This condition is used as random_lot==number, where number is the chance of winning the roll in percentage.

name: remain_distance
description: The number of meters remaining in the race.
exampleMeaning: There are exactly 200 meters remaining in the race.

name: remain_distance_viewer_id
description: The number of meters remaining in the race for any player character.
exampleMeaning: Any non-NPC character has reached the last 850 meters in the race.

name: rotation
description: The direction of the race.
exampleMeaning: The current race is run clockwise.

name: run_at_full_speed_random
description: Picks a random point during your Zenkai Spurt (全開スパート).
exampleMeaning: A random point during your Zenkai Spurt is selected.

name: running_style
description: Your running strategy.
exampleMeaning: You're a runner.

name: running_style_count_nige_otherself
description: The numbers of Front Runners in the race.
exampleMeaning: At least one of the other girls in the race is a Front Runner.
note: You're not included in this number.

name: running_style_count_oikomi_otherself
description: The numbers of End Closers in the race.
exampleMeaning: At least one of the other girls in the race is an End Closer.
note: You're not included in this number.

name: running_style_count_same
description: The number of characters with the same running strategy as you.
exampleMeaning: Nobody shares the same strategy with you (if you're a Front Runner, you're the only Front Runner).
note: You count as well.

name: running_style_count_same_rate
description: The percentage of characters with the same running strategy as you.
exampleMeaning: At least 40% of the girls in the current race have the same strategy as you (e.g. Front Runner).
note: You count as well.

name: running_style_count_sashi_otherself
description: The numbers of Late Surgers in the race.
exampleMeaning: At least one of the other girls in the race is a Late Surger.
note: You're not included in this number.

name: running_style_count_senko_otherself
description: The numbers of Pace Chasers in the race.
exampleMeaning: At least one of the other girls in the race is a Pace Chaser.
note: You're not included in this number.

name: running_style_equal_popularity_one
description: Checks if your running strategy is the same as the strategy of the most popular girl in the race.
exampleMeaning: You share the same running strategy with the #1 popular girl in the race.

name: running_style_temptation_count_nige
description: The number of Front Runners that are currently rushing (kakari).
exampleMeaning: There's at least one currently rushing Front Runner in the race.
note: You count as well.

name: running_style_temptation_count_oikomi
description: The number of End Closers that are currently rushing (kakari).
exampleMeaning: There's at least one currently rushing End Closer in the race.
note: You count as well.

name: running_style_temptation_count_sashi
description: The number of Late Surgers that are currently rushing (kakari).
exampleMeaning: There's at least one currently rushing Late Surger in the race.
note: You count as well.

name: running_style_temptation_count_senko
description: The number of Pace Chasers that are currently rushing (kakari).
exampleMeaning: There's at least one currently rushing Pace Chaser in the race.
note: You count as well.

name: running_style_temptation_opponent_count_nige
description: The number of enemy Front Runners that are currently rushing (kakari).
exampleMeaning: There's at least one currently rushing enemy Front Runner in the race.

name: running_style_temptation_opponent_count_oikomi
description: The number of enemy End Closers that are currently rushing (kakari).
exampleMeaning: There's at least one currently rushing enemy End Closer in the race.

name: running_style_temptation_opponent_count_sashi
description: The number of enemy Late Surgers that are currently rushing (kakari).
exampleMeaning: There's at least one currently rushing enemy Late Surger in the race.

name: running_style_temptation_opponent_count_senko
description: The number of enemy Pace Chasers that are currently rushing (kakari).
exampleMeaning: There's at least one currently rushing Pace Chaser in the race.

name: same_skill_horse_count
description: The number of girls that have this particular skill.
exampleMeaning: Among all the umas in the race, you're the only one with this particular skill.
note: You count as well.

name: season
description: The current season.
exampleMeaning: It's currently spring (either early spring or the cherry blossom season).
note: The "Cherry blossom" season refers to late spring, when cherry trees around the race track visibly bloom. Skills that are supposed to activate in spring will generally have "1 or 5" in their season conditions.

name: slope
description: Checks if you're currently running uphill or downhill.
exampleMeaning: You're currently running uphill.

name: straight_front_type
description: Checks if you're currently on a specific straight.
exampleMeaning: You're currently on a straight on the opposite side of the racecourse from where the audience is.

name: straight_random
description: Picks a random point on any straight.
exampleMeaning: A random point on any straight is selected.
note: First rolls for a straight segment, and then for a random point on that segment. Thus, if there's one very short straight and one very long straight, they both have the same chance to be selected. "Straight" generally only means the straight part of the track next to the stadium seatings, or the one across from there. In other words, tracks can have parts that are neither a straight nor a corner.
